text:
sam: Opening a PR with a short migration guide for autoscale schema v2 + an SDK snippet showing how to set isolation and scalePolicy in the Python client. Need quick docs review before I link it from the Dedicated handbook. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1288

elaine: Nice. Can you drop a minimal JSON payload for the API too? That helps infra and customers who use direct calls.

sam: Added JSON example in the PR description. Paste below: ```json
{
  "scalePolicy": {
    "minReplicas": 1,
    "maxReplicas": 10,
    "mode": "cpu_based",
    "cooldownSeconds": 90
  },
  "isolation": {
    "type": "reserved_pool",
    "selector": "pool=dedicated-apac"
  }
}
```

tariq: For the Python SDK snippet, prefer using the client helper `create_reserved_pool` so examples don't duplicate low-level fields. Also add a short note about backward compatibility: v1 `autoscale` keys get translated server-side for a limited deprecation period.

sam: Good call  added helper usage. New snippet: ```py
from redwood import InferenceClient
client = InferenceClient()
client.create_reserved_pool(name="dedicated-apac", gpus=4, labels={"pool": "dedicated-apac"}, scale_policy={"min_replicas":1, "max_replicas":10, "cooldown_seconds":90})
```

maria: docs-bot found two broken links in the draft: `/handbook/dedicated/old-scale` and `/sdk/python/old-client`

doc-bot: Linkcheck report: 2 broken links detected. Suggested replacements: `/handbook/dedicated/autoscale-v2` and `/sdk/python/client` (automated patch created on branch).

elaine: Can we also include a tiny troubleshooting section: what to check if reserved pool never scales (common culprits: wrong tenant selector label, insufficient GPU quota, or cooldown too high).

sam: Added a troubleshooting subsection and a bullet list. Also added a short note explaining `eviction_policy: soft` vs `hard` and when grace periods apply.

owen: Tiny phrasing nit: change "will be converted" to "is translated" for the deprecation note to avoid future tense confusion. Also avoid the phrase "best-effort" in the SLA sentence; use "service-level target" instead.

sam: Updated wording per suggestions and pushed. Can someone do a quick pass for grammar?

elainE: (typo) I meant to say I reviewed, all good now. Approving. :white_check_mark:

maria: Linkcheck now clean, automated patch applied, CI green.

doc-bot: CI: linkcheck passed, build OK, staged deploy succeeded.

sam: Merged. Notes for release: will backport a trimmed migration note to the 1.x handbook page and file a follow-up to remove v1 translation after deprecation window. Thanks all! :party_popper:
